# rest-design

Resource modelling, method semantics, status codes, idempotency and collection handling per HTTP semantics and common API style guides.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-REST-001` | low | Resources are plural nouns, not verbs |
| `AF-REST-002` | medium | HTTP methods carry their semantics |
| `AF-REST-003` | medium | Status codes describe outcomes, not transport |
| `AF-REST-004` | high | Collections are paginated by contract |
| `AF-REST-005` | medium | Unsafe operations accept idempotency keys |
| `AF-REST-006` | low | Errors follow Problem Details (RFC 9457) |
| `AF-REST-007` | medium | Versioning is a declared strategy, not an accident |
| `AF-REST-008` | low | Trailing-slash semantics are significant and consistent |
